values.not_included: Microsoft's sources show the plan doesn't include it.
values.partial: The plan includes it with a condition, given in the note.
values.addon: The plan doesn't include it, but an add-on that does can be bought for this plan. The add-on is named.
values.limit: The plan includes it with a stated limit or billing model, given in the text.
values.unclear: Microsoft's own sources conflict or don't say clearly. The note explains.
values.unverified: No Microsoft source either way after a full search.

basis.addon-column-convention: Add-on columns (the Defender and Purview suites) list only what the add-on adds, so a feature already in the base plan shows as not included there.

meta.method: Values are checked against Microsoft's own documentation, in order of authority: the Product Terms, Microsoft Learn licensing pages, Microsoft's service plan list, service descriptions, the plan comparison PDFs, then Microsoft's product and support pages. Where a value cites evidence, it covers what the feature needs and whether the plan carries it. Add-on suite columns list only what the suite adds, so a feature already in the base plan shows as not included there without a reference of its own. Values that no Microsoft source settles are marked unverified. A separate check re-researched about half of the values from scratch, and disagreements were settled against Microsoft's sources.

m365-features.csv.id: Our feature id, stable between versions.
m365-features.csv.<plan name>: One column per plan: Included, Not included, 'Add-on: <add-on>', 'Limit: <limit>', 'Partial: <condition>', 'Unclear: <why>' or Unverified.
m365-features.csv.source_url: A Microsoft page about the feature (for plan by plan sources, see m365-cells.csv).
m365-features.csv.last_checked: The latest date any of the feature's values was checked.

m365-cells.csv.value: One of the values in meta.values.
m365-cells.csv.addon: For add-on values, the add-on to buy.
m365-cells.csv.note: The condition, the reason a value is unclear, or why an add-on suite column shows not included.
m365-cells.csv.source_urls: The Microsoft pages behind the value, space separated. Empty for add-on suite columns that follow from the base plan, and for unverified values.
m365-cells.csv.checked: The date the value was checked.

fields.plans[].mappingConfidence: How the plan was matched to Microsoft's service plan list: 'settled' by its SKU, 'settled-no-sku' from Microsoft's plan guides or Product Terms (no SKU in the list), 'inferred' by name only.
